# Jeremiah 16 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Then the LORD spoke to me again:

**2** "Do not get married or have children in this place."

**3** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**4** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**5** This is what the LORD says: "Don't go to funerals or mourn for anyone or show any sympathy, because I have taken away My peace from these people — My unfailing love and My mercy," says the LORD.

**6** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**7** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**8** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**9** The LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, says: "Right here in this place, in your own lifetime, I am going to silence the sounds of joy and celebration — no more happy brides and grooms."

**10** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**11** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**12** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**13** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**14** "But the time is coming," says the LORD, "when people will no longer say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought the Israelites out of Egypt.'

**15** Instead they'll say, 'As surely as the LORD lives, who brought Israel back from the north and from all the countries He scattered them to.' I will bring them home to this land I gave their ancestors."

**16** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**17** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**18** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**19** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**20** The LORD continued describing the signs of coming judgment — no weddings, no funerals, no celebrations.

**21** "So I'm going to show them once and for all who I really am — My power and My strength. Then they will know that My name is the LORD."

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **16:1**: Jeremiah addresses signs of coming disaster — a message that confronted the comfortable assumptions of his audience.

- **16:10**: The forbidden mourning image captures something profound — a truth the original audience would have immediately felt in their bones.

- **16:21**: God seals this message with His signature declaration — 'I have spoken' — leaving no room for negotiation.

— PNEUMA
